{{Top|leg}}
'''Ultrasonic beam emitters''' were integral parts of [[Novaless Soni-Optics/Legends|Novaless Soni-Optics]] [[Target Imager]]. Two ultrasonic beam emitters operating on different frequencies were used to sight on a target. The differing wave patterns that returned were then used to build a three-dimensional "sound pattern."<ref name="Galladinium's Fantastic Technology">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref>
